scope: One fixed official two-page, native-text NPS brochure table, not a scanned-OCR, all-PDF, freshness, trail-access or safety benchmark.
configuration: OpenCode1.18.35; DeepSeekV4.1Flash/high; execution25requests (access300s/business600s), grading40requests/300s,32000outputtokens/request. Same image,2GiB/1CPU/pids256,pipTUNA, initially emptycache; freshhome/session/workspace. Two service execution streams, separate fresh graders.
account: Anonymous only; no account, key, payment or mutable remote resource created.
limit_enforcement: Service extraction count and >=1s spacing are instructions; model request, output and time limits are enforced. Stop after two consecutive 403/429/connection failures. MCP initialize/notifications/list calls are not extraction calls but are recorded in tools/time.

applicability.rule: Firecrawl 官方文档：keyless（无 API Key）使用 Scrape/Parse/Search 免费，按 IP 每日限额（两项限制：每日请求数与每日 credits），超额返回 429；未使用注册账号或付费方案。
applicability.observed: 本次两次调用均为匿名、请求未携带任何 API Key（scrape.py 仅设 Content-Type），POST /v2/scrape 两次均返回 HTTP 200、creditsUsed=2，未见 402/429 或付费超额，全程无付款方式。
applicability.evidence: official-route-sources/firecrawl-rate-limits.md 第 71-82 行免费规则；execution/artifacts/firecrawl_markdown.json 与 firecrawl_html.json 的 metadata（statusCode 200、creditsUsed 2）；evidence/firecrawl_scrape_evidence.md。

service_cost_judgment.note: 匿名 keyless 层级官方文档列为免费，本次 2 次调用均在免费额度内且无计费回执，故 service_cost_usd 记 0；未套用注册账号免费额度或付费 keyed 费率。

fee_limit: Official anonymous free rules matched to actual anonymous requests by the independent grader. Remaining quota and provider billing statement unavailable; public free result does not establish unlimited access. Credits are separate from dollar charges.
public_selection: Only minimal factual observations, selected short table data and original evidence hashes. Full PDF, images, maps, raw service responses, complete sessions and request identifiers remain private.
resources: All four dedicated batch containers stopped after independent review and complete usage collection.

reference_source.method: Direct HTTPS GET of official NPS source; no extraction-provider API.

document_identity.title: Zion Information Guide
document_identity.pdf_modification_date: 2026-07-31 (PDF metadata; not a claim about online release date)
document_identity.input_url_suffix: loader.cfm; official HTTP content type application/pdf;charset=UTF-8
document_identity.target_label: Hiking Guide, EASY through immediately before MODERATE

independent_reference_method: Task-design role directly downloaded official NPS PDF before service execution, extracted native text with pdftotext -layout, rendered both physical pages with pdftoppm and visually inspected them. Page 1 EASY black heading and MODERATE next heading bound exactly these five rows. Multiline Lower Emerald / Pool Trail is one name. Miles and feet are primary source values; do not recalculate from rounded km or m. No candidate API/response or prior executor answer used.
comparison: Both business executions collected and peer outputs sealed before separate grading; reference source PDF/derived files and official route rules were independently frozen before dispatch, grader-only. Graders cannot see peer verdicts.
retention_preparation: Controller archived access config and removed old example query/receipt fields and obsolete workspace-client pointers. No client/helper/answer added; no extra dependencies installed. Restarted both owned execution containers and verified unchanged config hashes, leaving only baseline processes. First Firecrawl restart verification mistakenly rejected normal uid1000 sleep/ps; audit recovery confirmed owner/config and repeated restart before business. No model replay; this is extra controller preparation, not unassisted reuse. Generic price claims in executor-written configs were not independently validated or corrected.
attribution: Selected factual table from National Park Service, Zion National Park, Summer-Infoguide-2026.pdf, printed Published5/18/2026. Extracted to CSV; values retain original miles/hours/feet. No endorsement; no whole brochure or third-party artwork reproduced.
cache_limit: No cacheState/cachedAt field was returned for either PDF response; freshness cannot be inferred. Each response reported2pages and2credits. Official PDF metering descriptions differ; these actual receipts do not resolve the general pricing rule.
format_observation: Executor requested markdown and then HTML and compared their EASY table values. Printed publication date was not present in returned text; requested table matched the frozen official PDF. Both formats may share the same underlying extraction, not independent provenance.
